def runlen(O,i,j,v,direction):
    di,dj=direction; L=0
    a,b=i+di,j+dj
    while 0<=a<30 and 0<=b<30 and O[a][b]==v: L+=1; a+=di; b+=dj
    a,b=i-di,j-dj
    while 0<=a<30 and 0<=b<30 and O[a][b]==v: L+=1; a-=di; b-=dj
    return L
dirs=[(0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(1,-1)]
def scores(O,i,j,cands):
    return {v:max(runlen(O,i,j,v,d) for d in dirs) for v in cands}
# verify rule on d1 and d3 ambiguous cells
print('d1:')
for (i,j) in amb1:
